tools.name: search_resorts
tools.description: Find PeakCam resorts by name (or part of one, or a region) and get their slugs with a one-line snow summary each. Call this first when the user names a resort; then use the slug with the other tools. Covers about 300 resorts in the US, Canada, Chile and Argentina.

tools.name: get_resort_cams

tools.description: Daily snow depth, snow water equivalent, precipitation accumulation and temperatures for the last 1–30 days at the resort's station (SNOTEL where there is one, Open-Meteo model otherwise), newest first. tools.description: Season opening and closing dates with status (open / closed / unknown) for every resort, or those in one state/province, soonest opening first. Confirmed dates come from the resort; projected ones are third-party estimates.

tools.name: get_resort_profile

tools.description: Every state, province and country PeakCam covers, with resort, reporting, measured (SNOTEL) and cam counts and the hub page URL. Call it to learn the valid `state` values for find_powder, get_opening_dates and get_percent_of_normal, or to answer "where does PeakCam have data".

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_resort_conditions, get_resort_cams, get_resort_profile, list_regions, get_alert_options, ask · Private data: get_resort_conditions, get_season_stats · Public sink: get_resort_cams, get_alert_options · Destructive: get_forecast, get_score.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_resort_conditions, get_resort_cams, get_resort_profile, list_regions, get_alert_options, ask · Private data: get_resort_conditions, get_season_stats · Public sink: get_resort_cams, get_alert_options · Destructive: get_forecast, get_score

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
